content.text:
This week (Mon 2 – Sun 8 March) you did **7 sessions, about 8h25m in total**. That's roughly 10% more than last week (7h40m), mostly from extra time on the bike.

## Sessions
| Day | Activity | Distance | Time | Avg HR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon | Pool swim | 2.5 km | 50 min (~2:00/100m) | 115 |
| Tue | Easy run | 10.5 km | 55 min (~5:14/km) | 133 |
| Wed | Pool swim | 2.2 km | 45 min (~2:03/100m) | 112 |
| Thu | Indoor trainer ride | 30 km | 1:00 | 128 |
| Fri | Long run | 15.2 km | 1:20 (~5:16/km) | 141 |
| Sat | Long road ride | 92.4 km | 3:05 (~30 km/h) | 132 |
| Sat | Strength | — | 30 min | 104 |

Nothing is logged for today (Sunday) yet.

## Compared with last week
- **Running:** 2 runs, 25.7 km. Last week was 3 runs and 27.2 km.
- **Cycling:** 2 rides, 122.4 km. Up from 3 rides and 110 km.
- **Swimming:** 2 swims, 4.7 km. Last week was 4.9 km.
- **Strength:** 1 session. Last week had none.
- **Training plan:** You completed 6 of 8 scheduled workouts (75%), and 5 of them were on the day they were planned.

## Things to watch
- **Saturday's long ride:** Your heart rate drifted up by 6.5% compared with your power in the second half. That's moderate drift, a little above the 5% range that counts as stable. It often comes from fatigue, heat or not drinking enough.
- **Sleep:** You averaged 6h25m with a sleep score of 72, and **3 of 6 nights were under 6 hours**. That's why the week is rated "yellow" overall.
- **Running shoes:** Your "Synthetic Trainer Shoe" has 742 of 800 km (93%), so it's time to think about replacing it.
- **Weight:** 70.2 kg on 5 March, down 0.4 kg from 24 February.

Garmin didn't report HRV, training load, VO2 max or training status for this week, so I can't tell you anything about those.
